summary: iter433 — Beta App Testing collection pages + admin status: comprehensive backend + frontend testing. 18/18 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter433_beta_collection.py pass (full apply payload + dedup on email+platform + cross-platform new-row, ack:false→400, missing name/invalid role/invalid platform/bad email→422, email_events row proves ops notification path with subject 'New Crafters Market beta tester signup — iOS', admin signups list returns statuses + new fields, legacy rows default status='pending' and mirror device→platform, PATCH status persists, invalid status→422, unknown id→404, missing auth→401/403, stats include apply rows, legacy /signup + config regression). iter428 legacy suite 7/7 still passes. Frontend flows verified on preview URL: /app-testing/android renders title 'Android App Beta Testing', form fills OK, submit blocked without ack, confirmation 'Thanks — your beta testing request has been received. If selected, we'll email you setup instructions.' shows; /app-testing/ios renders 'iOS App Beta Testing' with TestFlight copy, submit works, dedup verified via subsequent apply (duplicate:true); homepage BetaMiniCard buttons are real react-router <a href='/app-testing/{android,ios}'> Links (NOT window.open), navigation confirmed on both; /app-testing hero-join-{android,ios} and cta-join-{android,ios} all navigate() to the new collection pages, no legacy signup modal present.

issues: Cookie-consent banner overlaps the bottom of the form when initially rendered (Accept/Reject buttons cover part of the submit CTA on 1440x900 desktop). Test needed 'Accept' dismissal before submit could be clicked; real users on smaller viewports may see the same overlap. Consider z-index/padding-bottom adjustment on BetaSignupPage form container.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Increase bottom padding or raise submit button z-index on BetaSignupPage so the cookie-consent banner does not overlap the submit CTA.

(Environmental, not iter433) Admin dashboard on team@craftersmarket.org is currently gated by a 'Your password has expired' rotation modal (30-day policy). Frontend admin BetaProgramTab UI could not be exercised through the browser; the backend admin endpoints (list, PATCH status, auth) are fully covered by pytest and the tab source is clean. If you want a UI-level regression, either rotate the admin password or issue a fresh admin whose last_password_change_at is recent.
critical_code_review_comments: beta_program.py apply endpoint is clean: 400 on ack:false with a user-friendly message, 422 on Pydantic validation, correct dedup on (email,platform) reusing the device key so legacy stats counters keep working, background task fires the ops email without blocking response, status defaults to 'pending', ack:true persisted on the row.
admin_signups.setdefault('status','pending') + setdefault('platform', device) is the right way to keep legacy iter428 rows compatible in the admin table without a data migration.
PATCH /admin/beta-program/signups/{id} uses Literal enum on status (auto-422 on invalid) + explicit 404 on matched_count==0 + admin dependency for auth — textbook.

email_service.send_ops_beta_signup writes to email_events regardless of provider success/failure (via _record_event inside _send), which gives the audit trail the spec asks for. BETA_NOTIFY_EMAIL falls back to OPS_EMAIL when unset.

BetaSignupPage.jsx is 184 LOC single-file, correct required-field UX (browser required + JS ack guard + toast on missing name/email), passes ack:true explicitly so the server-side ack guard has real semantics, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env.

BetaMiniCard buttons are real react-router <Link> components with `to='/app-testing/{android,ios}'` — confirmed no window.open / no external play.google.com or testflight.apple.com href. AppTestingPage hero + bottom CTA are useNavigate() to the same paths. Legacy signup modal fully removed from AppTestingPage.jsx.
Minor / DRY: BetaSignupPage COPY blurb duplicates strings between the Android/iOS variants; a shared per-platform config module would let ops tweak marketing copy without touching JSX. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all public + landing flows; admin UI blocked by unrelated env-level password-rotation modal — backend admin API fully covered by pytest)

test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via issue_admin_magic_token('team@craftersmarket.org'); admin dashboard renders 'password expired' rotation modal from an unrelated 30-day policy — does not affect any iter433 endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Test emails prefixed 'beta-e2e-' — the pytest autouse fixture deletes both before and after each test. The two frontend end-to-end submissions (beta-e2e-front-android@example.com android + beta-e2e-front-ios@example.com ios) are still in db.beta_signups; main agent should clean them up with: db.beta_signups.delete_many({email: /^beta-e2e-/}) to avoid stats pollution.

Re-run backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter433_beta_collection.py /app/backend/tests/test_iter428_beta_program.py -v. The email path proof is a row in db.email_events with subject 'New Crafters Market beta tester signup — Android/iOS' (provider status may be sent/failed/skipped depending on Mailgun/Mailtrap keys in preview — presence of the event row is the acceptance criterion, per the request).
